ISA annual KRW20m per person, lifetime contributed max KRW100m, carryover and up to four contribution calendar years in ~3 actual years conditionally permits KRW80m per spouse. Monthly KRW1.67m×12 slightly exceeds annual quota and 36 months funds just KRW60m per person; issued notes are unsecured credit-risk securities and a 3yr dividend ETF cannot guarantee gains; DCA reduces timing concentration but historical global lump-sum usually outperformed cash-phase-in. (2) 45yo with apparently zero year-end liability: annual pension tax-credit base KRW6m savings+KRW3m IRP; non-credited pension principal can be taken tax-free but earnings taxable; ISA can be used for shorter liquidity, pension transfer additional 10% max KRW3m extra contribution credit base not guaranteed refunded tax, IRP withdrawals tightly restricted, marriage/childbirth gift KRW100m exemption only if legal conditions.
